source_findings: Placebo treatment refutation deliberately severs treatment-outcome association by randomization/permutation, re-estimates, and checks the induced null distribution.
Data-subset refutation repeatedly re-estimates on independently sampled subsets with reproducible per-simulation seeds.
Random-common-cause refutation injects a nuisance adjustment variable and measures estimate robustness.
Pinned upstream placebo regression tests explicitly expect placebo effects to collapse toward null relative to the original effect, including IV and multi-treatment cases.
f2_interpretation: For F2-WP-507, the transferable donor is a deterministic refutation family: matched null intervention, subset stability, and nuisance-variable perturbation. These are falsifiers around a causal-uptake claim, not a truth source and not evidence that GWT uptake exists.
counterhypothesis: A small F2-native refuter contract may capture the useful semantics more safely and cheaply than importing DoWhy; null transforms are invalid unless routing/recipient/provenance envelopes remain matched.
coordination: A separate R6-WP507-DOWHY-REFUTER-001 E2 objective was concurrently claimed. This mirror preserves only the completed E1 source-read result and intentionally grants no E2 credit.
